title: The Pilot and the Mermaid
description: Based on the book The Mermaid and the Pilot. A Navy fighter pilot crash lands on a tropical beach and falls in love with a beautiful mermaid.
quote: Oh, Pilot. I wish I could stay, but I can only breathe oxygen for twenty minutes at a time.
altHero: Austin Moon as a pilot, holding Brandy Baxter who is a mermaid
